text.text: Melee hits load 1 bullet into the chamber, up to 3. Right-click to fire loaded bullets as fast projectiles inheriting tool traits; each shot costs 1 durability; fire cooldown shrinks with attack speed. The gunblade has a 1-slot chamber holding any throwable item (Tinkers throwables, arrows): chamber ammo is thrown directly on fire (shuriken, throwing axes, snowballs, arrows), with a slightly longer cooldown. Sneak-use to open the chamber GUI and load or eject ammo.
